messages.content:
Risk: Data Privacy
Description: Impacts due to leakage and unauthorized use, disclosure, or de-anonymization of biometric, health, location, or other personally identifiable information or sensitive data.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/DataProtectionRequirement: data protection requirement — Requirements defining how data about individuals is held. Example is the EU DA directive and laws, which make the data the property of the individual that data is about. Covers - what information i sheld - who information can be divulged to. - the individual's rights in respect of that information Privacy regulations cover most of this. EU defines "Personal Data" and "Sensitive Personal Data". For credit reference agencies the latter would be covered. More detail about whether they can divulge facts which are not subject to formal judgements etc. [found by 22/50 queries]
  Siblings: notification obligation, delivery obligation, securities restriction
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000030: information content entity — A generically dependent continuant that is about some thing. [found by 18/50 queries]
  Siblings: Information Content Entity, normal value
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryReport: regulatory report — document required to support operational transparency that demonstrates compliance with some specification, law, policy, restriction, or other rule specified by a regulatory agency [found by 39/50 queries]
  Siblings: technical specification document, registry, transaction record
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data. [found by 35/50 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization. [found by 28/50 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the type of data (personal identifiers) that is at risk of being leaked or disclosed without authorization, which is central to the concern of data privacy.
This class represents the regulatory and legal frameworks that govern how personal data should be protected, which is instrumental in mitigating the risks associated with data privacy.
